description: The closed registry of «Путь Mnema» milestones (OB-E3, #531; ADR-ONB-002). Backend (MilestoneKey, the V74 CHECK, the inventory test) and frontend (path registry, texts, route keys) execute this fixture. Order is the display order. Authority: docs/engineering/onboarding/proposal.md layer 5 and architecture.md section 5.

visibility.AI_ASSESSMENT: Visible while the operator switch learning.features.ai-assessment.enabled is on (CapabilityFlags), not the runtime circuit breaker or budget.
visibility.COMMUNITY_CATALOG: Visible while a copy from the catalogue is possible: learning.community.catalog.enabled, learning.community.public-routes.enabled and learning.community.forks.enabled are on and the catalogue lists at least one deck.
visibility.RHYTHM: Visible while the weekly rhythm is on: learning.onboarding.rhythm.enabled (OB-401, default off). While it is off nothing writes the milestone and it is hidden.

milestones.counts: PUT /api/learning-profile: an answer or the deliberate skip (goal null).
A deck of the account is created: its own (DeckService.create), a copy (ForkService.copy) or the sample deck (ForkService.copyTemplate). A relink or an existing sample deck does not count again.

backfill.source: deck.owner_id, created_at (deleted decks included: the fact happened)

milestones.counts: A study session of mode SCHEDULED or PRACTICE completes (the row that changed to COMPLETE); REPLAY never counts. Any deck purpose counts, the sample deck included.

A NEW material is published in a deck of purpose USER (manual, capture conversion, Workshop approval: every create of ItemService.apply). A new revision, accepting an update of a copy and materializing a copy do not count; a SAMPLE deck does not count.

backfill.source: learning_item / item_revision created by the owner in a USER deck, excluding heads materialized from a copy

milestones.counts: Media appears in a material of a USER deck: a new material published with at least one media reference, or a new revision that references an asset its previous revision did not. Saving a material that already had the same media does not count.

backfill.source: content_media_ref of the owner joined to a USER deck

milestones.counts: Stages, not a counter: 1 when a note «На потом» is saved in a USER deck (CaptureService.create), 2 (done) when a note is sorted out: converted into a material (CaptureService.convert) or archived (CaptureService.archive).

backfill.source: capture_note: any row is stage 1, converted_at or archived is stage 2; hard-deleted notes are lost

milestones.counts: Counter: +1 for every NEW exercise published in a USER deck (manual create or Workshop create; a revision, an accepted update or a copy does not count), saturating at the target.

backfill.source: exercise_definition of the owner in USER decks, excluding copied definitions; progress = least(count, 3)

milestones.counts: An answer is concluded by the effective evaluator ai-semantic in a SCHEDULED or PRACTICE session (any deck, the sample deck's free checks included). Self-check, an uncertain or unavailable assessment and REPLAY do not count.

backfill.source: study_evidence.evaluator_id = 'ai-semantic' (SCHEDULED); practice answers whose outcome is gone after retention are lost

milestones.counts: A speech transcription of the account succeeds (any purpose: answer, editor field, note).

backfill.source: speech_input lives 15 minutes; only study_assessment.answer_source = 'SPEECH' survives

milestones.counts: At least one generated artifact is approved and published from the Workshop into a USER deck.

backfill.source: generation_provenance of the owner (outlives the session)

milestones.counts: A week of the weekly rhythm is met for the first time: a completed SCHEDULED or PRACTICE session brings the distinct local study dates of its ISO week (Monday first) to the weekly target (journey weeklyTarget, default 3); REPLAY never counts. Written only while learning.onboarding.rhythm.enabled is on.
milestones.writer: StudySessionRepository.complete, AttemptRepository.completeSessionIfTerminal (WeeklyRhythm), PUT /api/onboarding/preferences when a lowered target meets the current week

backfill.source: The target of a past week is not known (it is a setting that changes); the rhythm counts from the moment it is switched on

milestones.counts: Progress is the number of different local study dates (capped at 2) with a completed SCHEDULED or PRACTICE session; REPLAY never counts.
A copy of someone else's deck (ForkService.copy from a USER source: the catalogue or a public link). The sample deck does not count.

backfill.source: deck_fork of the owner whose upstream deck is USER and owned by another account

routes.PROFILE_GOAL: The goal block of the profile (in-place hint).
routes.DECKS: The deck list, the «Новая колода» control (in-place hint).
routes.STUDY: The account's most recent deck hub, the study control; the deck list when there is none (in-place hint).
routes.MATERIAL_NEW: The add-material control of the account's most recent USER deck hub; the deck list when there is none.
routes.EXERCISE_NEW: The materials list of the account's most recent USER deck hub (exercises are added to a material); the deck list when there is none.
routes.PROFILE_RHYTHM: The rhythm block of the profile (OB-401): the seven days of the week, the target and the weeks in rhythm.

params.key: a milestone key of this registry
params.done: visible milestones done after this one

notification.when: Only a LIVE record whose achieved_at was set by this very statement, and only while learning.onboarding.enabled is on. BACKFILL never notifies; a milestone achieved while the flag was off is never announced later.

rules: milestones lists the visible milestones in registry order; a hidden one is only named in path.hidden, whatever its stored state, and counts in neither done nor total.
state: DONE when achievedAt is set, PARTIAL when 0 < progress < target, TODO when there is no row. progress never exceeds target and achievedAt is set once.
Replaying the tour never resets the path: the rows are facts of the account's history.
Account purge (#409) deletes account_milestone by account_id.
